name: Identity and style reference adapters (IP-Adapter, FaceID, PuLID, InstantID, InfiniteYou, USO, Redux)
publisher: h94 / Tencent AI Lab (IP-Adapter, FaceID); ByteDance (PuLID, InfiniteYou, USO); InstantX (InstantID); Black Forest Labs (Redux); ComfyUI packs by cubiq, balazik, lldacing, bytedance; native nodes by Comfy-Org
stage_kind: adapter: every recipe is a FRAGMENT WITH AN ANCHOR - a full minimal graph for one host whose recipe.anchor lists host vs adapter node ids and where the adapter splices (MODEL line for IP-Adapter / PuLID / USOStyleReference; conditioning for Redux / USO subject / InfuseNet; both for InstantID)

cannot.what: IP-Adapter (cubiq pack) on FLUX / SD3 / Qwen: the pack's scope is SD1.5, SDXL, Kolors - for FLUX use USO (native), Redux (style), PuLID-Flux or InfiniteYou; for FLUX.2 PuLID-Flux2 or the model's native multi-reference; for Qwen-Image the Edit models
full identity fidelity from plain IP-Adapter (image prompting) - FaceID / PuLID / InstantID / InfiniteYou are the face methods; Redux is style/subject prompting, 'not a face-ID method'
PuLID: 'ID fidelity may not be high for some male inputs'
of any FLUX.1-dev-based adapter (Redux, PuLID-Flux, InfiniteYou, InstantX IP-Adapter), or of insightface-based pipelines (FaceID, PuLID, InstantID, InfiniteYou) without replacing the face embedder
expect new-model support from cubiq's three packs (IPAdapter_plus, PuLID_ComfyUI, InstantID): 'maintenance only' since 2025-04-14
quote per-GPU VRAM beyond the READMEs: PuLID-Flux ~22 GB fp16 / ~12 GB fp8-GGUF; InfiniteYou ~24 GB fp8 / ~43 GB bf16; everything else NOT FOUND
USOStyleReference / ReferenceLatent have no weight: style strength = number of chained style images; subject strength = reference size (512-1024)

params.name: weight
params.meaning: image-conditioning strength; README: 'lower the weight to 0.8 minimum and increase step count' to recover prompt adherence
params.range: -1..3 (IPAdapter, FaceID, Tiled, Embeds) or -1..5 (Advanced, Batch, StyleComposition, MS, PreciseStyleTransfer, ClipVisionEnhancer), step 0.05

params.name: weight_type
params.meaning: per-block weighting curve; simple node: standard / prompt is more important / style transfer; advanced: linear, ease in/out, weak input/output/middle, strong middle, style transfer, composition, strong style transfer, style and composition, style transfer precise, composition precise (the style/composition families target SDXL blocks)

params.name: start_at / end_at
params.meaning: fraction of sampling during which the adapter is active; PuLID upstream: earlier insertion = higher ID fidelity, lower editability ('timestep to start inserting ID' 4 for photoreal, 0-1 stylized - no official mapping to start_at, NOT FOUND)

params.name: weight_faceidv2
params.meaning: extra weight for the FaceID v2 insightface embedding

params.name: lora_strength / provider
params.meaning: FaceID LoRA strength (0-1) and insightface execution provider (CPU/CUDA/ROCM/DirectML/OpenVINO/CoreML); CUDA needs onnxruntime-gpu alone

params.name: combine_embeds / embeds_scaling
params.meaning: how several reference images merge (concat / add / subtract / average / norm average; StyleComposition default average) and which attention projections get the image embeds (V only, K+V, K+V w/ C penalty, K+mean(V) w/ C penalty)

params.name: method / weight
params.meaning: fidelity (closer to the reference ID) / style (more checkpoint freedom) / neutral (no normalization); ApplyPulidAdvanced adds projection (ortho_v2 / ortho / none), fidelity INT 0-32 ('lower values = higher reference resemblance'), noise -1..1

params.name: weight
params.meaning: PuLID-FLUX ID strength; options node (lldacing) adds input_faces_order (default large-small), input_faces_index, input_faces_align_mode

params.name: weight / ip_weight / cn_strength
params.input: weight (basic) | ip_weight 0-3, cn_strength 0-10, noise 0-1, combine_embeds average|norm average|concat (advanced)
params.meaning: basic node couples IP-adapter and IdentityNet strength in one weight; advanced splits them and exposes the ~0.35 negative-embed noise the README describes

params.name: strength / start_percent / end_percent
params.meaning: ControlNet-style controls of the InfuseNet; optional negative, vae, control_mask

params.name: image_proj_num_tokens / face_analysis_provider / det_size
params.meaning: ID projection tokens and insightface settings

params.name: strength / strength_type
params.meaning: Redux conditioning weight; multiply or attn_bias

params.name: largest_size
params.meaning: USO subject reference size: '512px is the recommendation from the UXO team, as it preserves more character features'; head-only references -> 1024 ('character taking up too much space' otherwise)

params.name: guidance / cfg
params.meaning: FLUX adapters run cfg 1 with FluxGuidance 3.5 (USO, Redux, PuLID-Flux: 'fake CFG' ~4 upstream, true CFG 'generally performs worse for photorealistic'); InstantID wants CFG '4-5 minimum' or RescaleCFG

params.name: resolution
params.meaning: InstantID: '1016x1016 works well' - 'Avoid 1024x1024 to prevent training watermarks'; PuLID examples 768x1024; InfiniteYou 864x1152; USO/Redux 1024x1024

rules.message: ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus supports SD1.5 / SDXL / Kolors only - not FLUX, SD3 or Qwen; on FLUX use USO (native), Redux, PuLID-Flux or InfiniteYou
every SD1.5 adapter and every SDXL *_vit-h adapter needs CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors; the wrong encoder is the 'tensor size mismatch' error (issue #108)
README: 'lower the weight to 0.8 minimum and increase step count' when the prompt is being ignored; or switch weight_type to 'prompt is more important' / a weak-* curve
InstantID README: CFG '4-5 minimum' (or use RescaleCFG) to avoid burn; the example runs 4.5
cubiq/PuLID_ComfyUI (ip-adapter_pulid_sdxl_fp16) is SDXL only; FLUX uses ApplyPulidFlux from the PuLID-Flux pack
pulid_flux_v0.9.x is a FLUX.1-dev (or Krea-dev) patch; it does not load on SDXL / FLUX.2
InfiniteYou's InfuseNet is built for FLUX.1-dev (the pack example runs schnell fp8); not for SDXL
the official example wires the FLUX VAE into InfuseNetApply (optional input) - a ControlNet-style latent hint
USO is the DiT LoRA + the projector patch together; the template always loads both
USOStyleReference's clip_vision_output must come from sigclip_vision_patch14_384 (SigLIP), not a CLIP-ViT encoder
FLUX Redux encodes the reference with sigclip_vision_patch14_384; the IP-Adapter ViT-H/bigG encoders are the wrong input
Redux 'can be used with any Flux1 dev or schnell model workflow' - nothing else
the USO subject branch sets FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod to 'uxo/uno' after ReferenceLatent (template); style-only graphs have no reference latent and skip it
USO reference: 512 px preserves character features (UXO team); head-only crops need 1024; outside that range is untested by the template

the USO template samples at cfg 1.0 with FluxGuidance 3.5 and ConditioningZeroOut as negative (FLUX distilled guidance); Redux and PuLID-Flux use a BasicGuider, which has no cfg - PuLID upstream: true CFG 'generally performs worse for photorealistic scenarios'
USO needs ComfyUI >= 0.3.57 and lldacing's PuLID-Flux >= 0.3.7 - both below the pinned 0.35.0; no recipe here is pending on version

prompting.negative_note: the negative is the HOST's: FLUX graphs use ConditioningZeroOut (USO) or none (Redux/PuLID-Flux with BasicGuider); the InstantID example's negative is 'photograph, deformed, glitch, noisy, realistic, stock photo' for its comic prompt; SDXL examples 'text, watermark'

positive.line: IP-Adapter competes with the text: weight <= 0.8 and more steps, or weight_type 'prompt is more important' / weak-input / style-transfer curves; IPAdapterPromptScheduleFromWeightsStrategy schedules prompts against IPAdapterWeights for animations
PuLID: method 'style', lower weight or later start_at give the prompt and checkpoint more freedom; 'fidelity' and early insertion lock the face
InstantID: strong structural lock from keypoints - use image_kps to change pose; style prompts ('comic character ...') still apply; CFG 4-5
InfiniteYou: aes_stage2 for better text-image alignment; FLUX guidance 3.5
USO: 'You can disable all reference image inputs and use this workflow as a subject-driven image generation workflow'; style strength is the number of chained style images
Redux: 'Even without a prompt, this model can still apply the image styles from the reference images'
Editing models (Kontext / Qwen-Image-Edit / FLUX.2): identity comes from the input image; the prompt describes the change

prompting.structure: the host family's prompt rules apply; describe the scene/style, let the adapter carry the face

hurts.line: adapter weight at the top of its range with a detailed prompt: the prompt is ignored (IP-Adapter README)
1024x1024 with InstantID (training watermarks) and CFG below 4 (burn)
low-quality / tiny reference faces: 'Quality of the reference image is very important' (PuLID)

pitfalls.symptom: 'ClipVision model not found' / 'IPAdapter model not found'
pitfalls.cause: the unified loader regex-matches filenames in models/clip_vision and models/ipadapter
pitfalls.fix: rename the encoders exactly to CLIP-ViT-H-14-laion2B-s32B-b79K.safetensors / CLIP-ViT-bigG-14-laion2B-39B-b160k.safetensors and keep h94's adapter filenames

pitfalls.cause: 'wrong combination of IPAdapter model, image encoder and/or base checkpoint' (vit-h vs bigG, SD1.5 adapter on SDXL); or the deprecated IPAdapter_ComfyUI extension still installed
pitfalls.fix: pair per the rules; remove the old extension ('IPAdapter Apply' was replaced by IPAdapterAdvanced); dtype errors -> --force-fp16

pitfalls.cause: insightface / onnxruntime missing from ComfyUI's Python
pitfalls.fix: pip install insightface onnxruntime (Linux: usually plain pip; Windows wheels cp39-cp313 at Gourieff/Assets; Python 3.12+/RTX 50: build per insightface issue #2779 - onnx 1.18.0, insightface 0.7.3 from source, 'comment out onnx from requirements.txt')

pitfalls.symptom: insightface runs on CPU despite CUDA / provider CUDA errors
pitfalls.fix: 'You should only install ONE package of either onnxruntime (CPU) or onnxruntime-gpu' - uninstall both, install onnxruntime-gpu alone (CUDA 12 from ORT 1.17)

pitfalls.symptom: PuLID / InstantID / InfiniteYou cannot find insightface models
pitfalls.cause: antelopev2 nested as antelopev2/antelopev2/, or only buffalo_l present
pitfalls.fix: the five .onnx files directly in ComfyUI/models/insightface/models/antelopev2/ ('antelopev2 (NOT buffalo_l)'); IP-Adapter FaceID uses buffalo_l, auto-downloaded into the same root

pitfalls.symptom: PuLID-Flux keeps influencing the model after the node is disconnected ('model pollution'); attn_mask does nothing
pitfalls.fix: use lldacing/ComfyUI_PuLID_Flux_ll (same node ids - install only one), put ApplyPulidFlux BEFORE TeaCache/WaveSpeed patches

pitfalls.symptom: PuLID-Flux crashes or gives blurry backgrounds
pitfalls.cause: 'Incompatible with CUDA compute capability < v8.0'; 'FP8 requires bfloat16 support'; 'FP8 e5m2 produces blurry backgrounds'
pitfalls.fix: fp16/bf16 or fp8 e4m3fn, or GGUF Q8 via city96/ComfyUI-GGUF (~12 GB)

pitfalls.symptom: PuLID likeness weak on a male face
pitfalls.cause: upstream limitation ('ID fidelity may not be high for some male inputs')
pitfalls.fix: raise weight / earlier start_at; or InstantID (SDXL) / InfiniteYou (FLUX)

pitfalls.symptom: InstantID burn, watermark-like artifacts, copied pose
pitfalls.cause: CFG below 4, 1024x1024, no negative noise, reference pose reused
pitfalls.fix: CFG 4-5 or RescaleCFG, 1016x1016, ApplyInstantIDAdvanced noise ~0.35, image_kps from a separate pose photo

pitfalls.symptom: USO output: character too large / features lost
pitfalls.fix: 512 px for full-body/half-body references; 1024 for head-only crops

pitfalls.symptom: tried IP-Adapter on FLUX / SD3 / Qwen
pitfalls.fix: USO (native), Redux (style), PuLID-Flux, InfiniteYou; FLUX.2: native multi-reference or PuLID-Flux2; Qwen: Edit models

pitfalls.symptom: no new-model support from the IP-Adapter / PuLID-SDXL / InstantID packs
pitfalls.fix: they still load; for new models use the native nodes or the editing families
